integrity: The primary source was checked at its exact real norm proof, including the strip map, subordinate disk self-map, Littlewood step, and explicit attaining trace. The new argument rescales the subordinate map by its finite-radius Schwarz quotient, then uses strict radial growth of the Riesz mean and maximum-modulus rigidity. No numerical experiment is used.
scientific_limitations: The refinement is for real-valued zero-mean data and 1<p<infinity. The Schwarz quotient q_r is intrinsic to the strip lift but is not converted here into a boundary-space distance, so the result is not a full quantitative stability theorem in L-infinity. The complex endpoint problem is untouched.
title: Schwarz-gap rigidity for real Poisson extremizers
